review_candidates.title: Satış Uzmanı (İngilizce veya Almanca)
review_candidates.description: Hakkımızda: Clineca, ileri tıbbi uzmanlık, yenilikçi teknolojiler ve müşteri odaklı yaklaşımıyla sağlık turizmi sektöründe öncü bir şirket olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 2021 yılında kurulan Clineca, İstanbul merkezli operasyonlarıyla uluslararası hasta memnuniyetini en üst düzeyde tutmaya odaklanmıştır.  İş Özeti: Bu pozisyonda, uluslararası müşterilerle mesajlaşma kanalları üzerinden iletişim kurarak satış sürecini yönetecek, müşteri memnuniyetini artıracak ve şirketin büyümesine katkıda bulunacaksınız. Sağlık turizmi sektörünün dinamik ortamında, düzenli ve hedef odaklı çalışarak performansa dayalı kazanç elde edeceksiniz. Genel Nitelikler: • İleri düzeyde İngilizce veya Almanca yazılı ve sözlü iletişim becerisine sahip, • Üniversitelerin ön lisans veya lisans bölümlerinden mezun veya en az 2 yıl satış deneyimi olan, • WhatsApp ve dijital platformlarda yazılı iletişim yönetiminde yetkin, • CRM araçları (özellikle Pipedrive) kullanımı konusunda deneyimli veya öğrenmeye istekli, • İletişim ve ikna kabiliyeti güçlü, hedef bazlı çalışma disiplini olan, • Düzenli, sonuç odaklı ve zaman yönetimi konusunda başarılı, • Pozitif, çözüm odaklı ve müşteri memnuniyetine önem veren. Görev Tanımı: • Potansiyel müşterilerle WhatsApp ve diğer dijital kanallar üzerinden etkili iletişim kurarak satış sürecini baştan sona yönetmek. • Hastaların beklentilerini anlamak, süreci yönetmek ve hizmet mükemmelliği sunmak. • Hastalara medikal turizm paketleri için fiyat teklifleri sunmak. • Hastalar ve doktorlar arasında randevu planlaması yapmak ve bu süreçlerin takibini sağlamak. • Mevcut, geçmiş ve potansiyel hastalarla iletişim kurarak sadakati artırmak. • CRM aracı Pipedrive üzerinden satış süreçlerini düzenli olarak takip etmek ve raporlamak. Faydalar: • Performansa dayalı yüksek gelir potansiyeli ile sektörden ayrışan bir başarı. • Sektörün en kaliteli ve yüksek sayıda müşteri adayları (lead): Başarı için güçlü bir temel, • Eğitim ve kariyer geliştirme fırsatları, • Teknoloji paketi : Mobil telefon ve MacBook, • Dinamik, destekleyici ve çok kültürlü bir çalışma ortamı. Çalışma Şekli: Tam zamanlı, ofis bazlı ve hibrit çalışma modeline uygun bir pozisyon sunuyoruz.

review_candidates.description: Location: Stuttgart, Germany Work Days in Office: 5 days a week Travel: Ability and willingness to travel at least 30% of the time throughout Africa, with additional international travel as needed Position Type: Full-Time FLSA Status : Exempt Post: Accompanied About Spirit of America: Spirit of America is a privately funded 501c3 nonprofit headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. Our mission is to engage citizens in preserving the promise of a free and better life. We do this by working alongside US troops and diplomats and providing private assistance to defend freedom, strengthen America’s security, and save and improve lives. Spirit of America leverages an unprecedented partnership with the US military based on a groundbreaking agreement with the Department of Defense. Our agreement with the Department of Defense allows the military to collaborate with us, identify needs, receive and distribute our assistance, and provide us with logistical support. No other nonprofit has such an agreement. Thus, every dollar invested in Spirit of America builds on and leverages investments made by the US government and military. That leverage — combined with our entrepreneurial, venture capital capability — provides philanthropic investments in Spirit of America with asymmetric impact and return on investment. Our work saves and improves lives, prevents conflict, and strengthens America’s security. In the world’s toughest places, people experience the best of who U.S. people are and what we stand for. About the Role: The Regional Program Manager, Africa will work in close cooperation and coordination with U.S. diplomatic, military, and civil society officials across Africa to support shared objectives. They will provide targeted private assistance and solutions to complex problems in support of U.S. mission effects and objectives. The Regional Program Manager will report to the Regional Director. This is a full-time position based in Stuttgart, Germany , with extensive travel throughout Africa and occasional travel worldwide in support of Spirit of America operations. The ideal candidate will bring significant field experience in Africa, a strong understanding of the region's political, security, economic, and social dynamics, and the ability to develop trusted relationships with U.S. Government and African partners at multiple levels. Reports To: Regional Director, Africa Direct Reports: None Key Responsibilities: Collaboratively develop projects and initiatives in response to local needs identified by all levels of U.S. Government partners—from Team to Headquarters and Country Team level—in support of U.S. mission effects and objectives across Africa. Manage projects end to end, including logistics, record keeping, payments, negotiating, and budgeting in accordance with industry best practices and Spirit of America standards. Serve as a conduit for U.S. private-sector expertise to provide input to, and help develop, solutions for local projects in areas such as agriculture, education, health, economic development, security, information, entrepreneurship, and governance. Work directly with senior government, military, and civil society partners in African countries, as well as their working-level staff, to implement country strategies and programs in support of critical objectives. Build and maintain strong working relationships with U.S. Embassies, African partner governments, militaries, civil society organizations, and other relevant stakeholders throughout the region. Document the results of Spirit of America-supported projects with photos, video, blog posts, and stories; public-facing materials to be coordinated with Spirit of America's marketing and communications teams. Work closely with U.S.-based Spirit of America staff to develop creative ways to incorporate the support of the U.S. people to make a rapid, tangible difference on the ground. Engage, in coordination with the marketing and communications teams, journalists in covering Spirit of America's work, as appropriate. Monitor emerging political, security, economic, humanitarian, and development issues across the region and identify opportunities where Spirit of America can provide targeted, timely, and locally appropriate assistance. What Success Looks Like in This Role: Established a portfolio of high-impact, country security focused projects in Africa, with independent management responsibility for implementation and performance Developed productive working relationships with AFRICOM and SOCAF collaborators, and opened lines of communication with deployed units in key focus areas in Africa Contributed compelling regional content to Spirit of America marketing and communication efforts Supported Development colleagues in fundraising and donor outreach efforts as required. Key Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in international relations, international development, public administration, security studies, or a related field. Master's degree preferred. Minimum eight (8) years experience managing international projects and including (1) year of experience managing projects or programs, including budget management and reporting Significant, direct U.S. foreign policy and/or country security-related experience at the field level in Africa. Demonstrated experience working on the ground in U.S. security, stability, development, and/or partner capacity-building missions in Africa. Experience engaging directly with local populations and understanding local issues, institutions, cultures, and dynamics. Experience partnering with African governments, militaries, civil society organizations, and/or local community leaders. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English are essential. Proficiency in French or other languages commonly spoken in Africa is highly preferred. Arabic, Portuguese, or relevant African languages may be particularly valuable depending on the candidate's country and regional experience. Experience working in multiple African countries and/or supporting issues related to different sub-regions of Africa is highly preferred. Willingness and ability to travel extensively throughout Africa and occasionally worldwide is required. Ability to work effectively from Stuttgart, Germany, while maintaining relationships and supporting programs across multiple African countries and time zones. Candidates must be U.S. citizens, as this role requires eligibility for a U.S. Government security clearance. Compensation Range: Salary ranges from $102,000.00 to $120,000.00 based on experience. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, and 403(b) contribution match to 4%. Equal Employment Opportunity: Spirit of America is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on merit and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or other protected characteristics in accordance with applicable laws.

Shape the future of veterinary care: Play a key role in supporting the strategic growth and optimisation of the MVHE veterinary network across Central Europe. Lead high-impact projects: Own the end-to-end delivery of new clinic launches, relocations, mergers and closures, turning strategic plans into successful operational outcomes. Work across borders and functions: Partner with Operations, Property, IT, HR, Finance and Clinical leadership across diverse European markets. Build scalable ways of working: Develop and embed consistent PMO frameworks, tools and processes while adapting delivery to local market needs and regulations. Make a visible difference: Bring structure, insight and continuous improvement to a growing veterinary network, helping teams deliver projects safely, efficiently and effectively. The team You will join the MVHE PMO team within the broader Global REFM organisation, supporting the strategic and transformational agenda. Reporting to the Senior PMO Manager, the OU PMO Manager will work closely with the Central Operations team and functional leaders across Mars Veterinary Health Europe (MVHE). You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, coordinating complex, cross-functional projects across multiple countries and markets. The role provides an opportunity to work across the full project lifecycle, from investment appraisal and planning through implementation, operational readiness and post-project review. You will help establish scalable approaches to project delivery while ensuring local market, cultural, legal and veterinary regulatory requirements are appropriately considered. The role initially operates as an individual contributor, with the potential to develop as the wider PMO team evolves. What You'll Do Lead the delivery of new veterinary clinic openings, relocations, mergers and closures across Central Europe. Own project plans, budgets, timelines, risks and governance from start to finish. Bring Operations, Property, IT, HR, Finance and Clinical teams together to deliver successful projects. Turn global strategy into practical plans that work for local markets and regulatory requirements. Keep senior stakeholders informed through clear reporting, KPIs and recommendations. Identify smarter, more consistent ways of delivering projects and embed lessons learned across the PMO. Support investment decisions, financial modelling and cost-effective project delivery. What We're Looking For Proven project or programme management experience: At least 5 years' experience in project/programme management, including significant experience managing complex, cross-functional projects. Relevant industry experience: At least 3 years' experience in healthcare, veterinary operations or another regulated, operationally complex environment.(Preferred) Strong stakeholder leadership: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align people across functions, seniority levels and countries. Strong delivery discipline: Experience managing project plans, budgets, risks, dependencies and governance across multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. International mindset: Ability to understand and balance global strategy with local market requirements, including relevant legal and regulatory considerations. Language Skills : German and English fluency is mandatory. Polish language skills are desirable You'll also bring a strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach to delivery. Experience working with project management tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet or equivalent is important. A PRINCE2, PMP or similar project management qualification would be an advantage. Experience in veterinary, healthcare or clinical environments is preferred, as is knowledge of veterinary legislation across multiple countries. The role involves international travel, so willingness and ability to travel as required is essential. What We Offer The opportunity to contribute to our purpose of creating A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS. An international role working across multiple European markets and functions. The opportunity to influence how complex veterinary network projects are delivered at scale. A collaborative and inclusive working environment. Access to wellbeing support and programmes. Opportunities for learning, development and career progression. A flexible working approach, subject to role and business requirements. About Us Mars Veterinary Health (MVH) Europe is a family of leading veterinary care providers committed to creating A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS . Our network includes trusted brands such as AniCura and Linnaeus, operating over 450 animal hospitals and clinics across 18 European countries. Together, our teams deliver high-quality, modern veterinary care, ensuring peace of mind for pet owners through excellent access and patient safety. At MVH Europe, we prioritise a culture of accountability, inclusion and wellbeing. We believe our purpose — to make A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS — starts with building a better world for our people. We support our teams through comprehensive wellbeing programmes, clear development and career paths, and a shared passion for delivering exceptional outcomes in veterinary care. Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, please speak to us. This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. Ready to join our quest for better? Job Description The Interpreter reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine (NM), adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards. Conducts medical and general interpreting for patients and their families, physicians, and the healthcare team in accordance with the National Standards of Practice of NCIHC designed to facilitate the language needs at Northwestern Memorial Hospital. Assesses and monitors patients’ understanding of information conveyed, and serves as a cultural mediator. Records and monitors interpretation activities according to department standards. Makes decisions regarding prioritization of multiple requests received at one time. Responsibilities: Medical Interpreting: Provides medical and general interpreting services to patients, family members, support persons and healthcare providers and other staff in accordance with the National Standards of Practice (NCIHC). This includes interpreting during consultations and diagnostic testing; medical procedures and operations; the consent process and educational forums. Ensures that the patient’s and family’s needs are communicated to healthcare providers and staff. Screens multiple requests for interpreters and prioritizes requests based on urgency of need. Assists the healthcare team in problem solving and complaint resolution related to the limited English-Proficient population. Participates in ongoing professional development to maintain practice in accordance with professional medical interpreting standards. Communication and Collaboration: Initiates and develops positive relationships with patients, visitors, healthcare providers, fellow interpreters and staff, exhibiting respect, flexibility and cooperation at all times. Serves as a cultural mediator, as necessary and when appropriate, to enhance communication between American culture staff and native culture patients/families, as it relates to medical care. Supports and participates in the continuous assessment and improvement of the interpretation services program. Assists with other departmental functions as assigned Actively participates in staff meetings and mandatory in-services. Documentation: Maintains documentation of all interpretation encounters, to include relevant data such as location, duration, and purpose. Documents all interpreting encounters accurately and completely, including patient refusals of interpreting services. Maintains accurate records of productivity, work volumes, and interpreting requests. Additional Functions: Proven software competencies (Excel, Word) Adaptable to relevant software necessary for data tracking and trending AA/EOE #NMH1 Qualifications Minimum Requirements: Education: Completion of high school education or equivalent. Certification: Must hold a certificate of completion substantiating formal training and qualifications for medical interpreting in accordance with the National Standards of Practice (NCIHC). Experience: Minimum of three years’ experience in providing medical interpreting in an acute care setting. Behavioral Attributes: High level of fluency in English, and another language, both oral and written. Ability to interpret effectively, accurately, and impartially both receptive and expressive, using medical terminology as appropriate. Ability to maintain professional demeanor in all situations. Knowledgeable about the issues of cultural competency and healthcare disparities. Adaptable and sensitive in cross-cultural situations. Excellent communication, organizational and customer service skills. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act. Artificial Intelligence Disclosure Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person. Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

Flexible working arrangements with potential for hybrid/remote work Be part of a results-oriented, entrepreneurial, pragmatic, science-based, and fast-moving team that is highly qualified and deeply driven to advance sustainable development. Be part of a well-established and important global movement, including CSP's ~300-strong wealth holder alumni community. Have a tangible impact on sustainable development through our specific vantage point. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives who are passionate about impact and advancing our mission. We look forward to hearing from you!
